editionData.description: Global headlines: Israeli settlers beat AFP photographer covering violence in West Bank (Jaafar Ashityeh, 58, was attacked during reporting the same story — settler attacks during the Palestinian olive harvest — last year, too); Protests sweep France, as student walkouts tap into public discontent (Thousands have been detained and classes were canceled for the rest of this week as the student protests tapped into French anger over austerity measures); and Seventh person arrested in suspected plot to attack U.S. planes in Britain (A 22-year-old British national was detained in connection with the allegedly Iranian-backed plot). Markets leaned lower, with 5 of 7 tracked indexes down; Nikkei 225 down 0.92% was the largest move. Benchmarks tracked: S&P 500, NASDAQ Composite, Euronext 100 Index, and Public Joint-Stock Company Moscow Exchange MICEX-RTS plus 3 more indexes. Hacker News: Sharing AI progress in mathematics (OpenAI publishes new results on open problems in mathematics from an internal frontier model and shares Lean proof formalizations and...); Strands Decider 2B: a small, open-source, decision model (Strands Decider 2B is a small, open source, decision model optimized for fast experimentation, local development, and innovation); and Decisions API is in public beta (Use the Decisions API to check conditions, select from fixed options, and score text and images against a rubric). Product Hunt features Zavi (Lovable for growth), Velozity (Multiplayer platform for your teams and AI Agents), and Takweem AI (The AI calendar that makes room for your most important work).

headlines.title: Israeli settlers beat AFP photographer covering violence in West Bank
headlines.summary: Jaafar Ashityeh, 58, was attacked during reporting the same story — settler attacks during the Palestinian olive harvest — last year, too.

headlines.title: Protests sweep France, as student walkouts tap into public discontent
headlines.summary: Thousands have been detained and classes were canceled for the rest of this week as the student protests tapped into French anger over austerity measures.

headlines.title: Seventh person arrested in suspected plot to attack U.S. planes in Britain
headlines.summary: A 22-year-old British national was detained in connection with the allegedly Iranian-backed plot.

headlines.title: Germany arrests former intelligence chief in espionage case
headlines.summary: August Hanning is accused of selling state secrets to at least one foreign state. It could be the worst breach at the German foreign intelligence agency since the Cold War’s end.

headlines.title: Intelligence on potential Iranian drone attack led U.S. to move bombers
headlines.summary: Multiple streams of intelligence warned of possible attacks on the U.K. base hosting the aircraft, according to people familiar with the decision, with concerns rising after police arrested five men in white vans.

headlines.title: Houthi missiles hit Aden airport; another intercepted over Saudi’s Riyadh
headlines.summary: Saudi-led coalition continues to battle Yemen's Iran-aligned rebels as they target civilian infrastructure.

headlines.title: How three years of Israel’s genocidal war have changed Gaza
headlines.summary: War has devastated Gaza’s economy, education, healthcare, infrastructure and public services, transforming life.

headlines.title: Libya’s parliament removes Speaker Saleh after 12 years as discontent grows
headlines.summary: Eastern-based parliament votes to replace longtime speaker with Al-Salhin Abdelnabi al-Obeidi.

headlines.title: Oman evacuates injured crew from attacked tanker in Strait of Hormuz
headlines.summary: India's Foreign Ministry says 11 out of 12 injured crew members on board the On Peace are Indian nationals.

headlines.title: Three years of Israel’s genocide in Gaza: In numbers
headlines.summary: Three years of attacks has devastated Gaza, killing tens of thousands, destroying homes, and collapsing basic services.

headlines.title: Former CIA official accused of stealing $40M in gold bars pleads guilty
headlines.summary: A former senior CIA official pleaded guilty Tuesday to a charge that he abused his position to enrich himself by acquiring Florida real estate and hundreds of gold bars worth over $40 million.

headlines.title: Israelis mourn on the anniversary of the Oct. 7 as Palestinians grapple with war it sparked
headlines.summary: Israelis are gathering Wednesday to commemorate the Oct. 7, 2023, attack that killed 1,200 people, and sparked a devastating war in Gaza that Palestinians still grapple with.

headlines.title: Actress Eva Marie Saint, who won an Oscar for 'On the Waterfront,' dies at 102
headlines.summary: Saint won an Oscar for her portrayal of Edie, a Catholic schoolgirl whose longshoreman brother is murdered. She went on to star in Alfred Hitchcock's North by Northwest.

headlines.title: Cornell names former acting U.S. attorney general to review rape case
headlines.summary: Cornell University names Sally Yates, former acting U.S. attorney general and career federal prosecutor, to lead an independent review into how the school handled a former student's rape allegations.

headlines.title: France's police fire tear gas and water cannons as school protests sweep the country
headlines.summary: More than a quarter of a million people rallied nationwide to support school students demanding more education funding, according to government figures, with thousands of arrests.

headlines.title: Washington blames UK base incident on a 'foreign actor'
headlines.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the "hands of a foreign actor" were involved in an incident in which five men were arrested on suspected explosives and terrorism offenses near a British air base used by US forces.

headlines.title: Chancay Port rides a new trade current
headlines.summary: For Santos Javier Gonzales, the deep-water mega port taking shape in his hometown of Chancay, Peru, has become part of his own story — enabling him to build a career without leaving his family behind.

headlines.title: Landmark Chinese garden takes root in England
headlines.summary: SALFORD, England — After nearly eight years in the making, a Chinese garden that authorities describe as the largest of its kind in Europe has opened in Salford, bringing a distinctive Chinese presence to the horticultural landscape of northern England.

headlines.title: Ukraine's provocations fuel tensions, Putin says
headlines.summary: MOSCOW/KYIV — Russian President Vladimir Putin said on Friday that an escalation of tensions would not achieve the outcome sought by Kyiv and could only worsen the situation in Ukraine.

headlines.title: Japan protests to US over alleged robbery-murder by Marine in Okinawa
headlines.summary: TOKYO - A 20-year-old US Marine stationed in Japan's southernmost prefecture of Okinawa was arrested by local police on Sunday on suspicion of robbing and murdering a woman, local media reported.

headlines.title: Rahul’s protest a political drama, claims made by Congress are lies: BJP
headlines.summary: BJP calls Rahul Gandhi's protest a political drama, claims ECI did not receive Congress requests, exposing alleged lies and spectacle.

headlines.title: Home Ministry moves out 3 of 5 officers from division hit by bribery allegations
headlines.summary: MHA shuffles three officials amid bribery probes linked to FCRA registrations, following Delhi Police arrests of two narc credentialed workers.

headlines.title: The protest that wouldn’t end: Inside Rahul Gandhi’s daylong siege of Akashvani Bhawan
headlines.summary: Rahul Gandhi leads a daylong sit-in at Akashvani Bhawan, turning AIR into a tense protest site amid police action and political drama.

headlines.title: We Will Do It: PM Modi gives new slogan to make India developed nation by 2047
headlines.summary: PM Modi launches "We Will Do It" slogan, outlining a developed India by 2047 through policy vision, unity, and hard work.

headlines.title: CEC Gyanesh Kumar’s Chhattisgarh visit postponed
headlines.summary: CEC Gyanesh Kumar’s Chhattisgarh visit postponed due to unavoidable reasons; revised dates to be announced.
